source_title: 'Garam paani piyo, thanda mat peena': Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's reaction to fan goes viral

He can smash sixes, score runs at a stunning pace and put opposition attacks under pressure. Yet, away from the cricket field, he is still a young boy who brings out the protective side of people around him.A recent video from Wellington, New Zealand, shows exactly why the teenager has become a fan favourite in such a short time.After India's third T20I against New Zealand, Sooryavanshi went near the boundary to sign autographs for fans.
